## Story vs Typology evidence
Root markdown files (`mission.md`, `architecture.md`, etc.) constitute the teaching story for gitboard.
`evidence/typology/` contains Typology seed evidence for this digest proposal (e.g., `architecture_brief.md`). These briefs are not the teaching story and do not represent the confirmed `.typology/` catalog.
